$comment: Explicit exceptions for the boundary/naming lints (tasks 0.2, 0.3, 0.5). Each entry is a violation that existed when the lint was introduced; new violations are NOT allowed. Remove an entry when its violation is fixed (a stale entry is reported as a warning). Fields: rule, package (repo-relative dir), target (offending import / dependency / command path / binary), since (YYYY-MM-DD), reason. Do not add entries to silence new code.
